mapper.sql:
SELECT C.WK_ID, C.CLASS_SEQ, C.CLASS_NM, C.DOC_TYP_CD, C.MATCH_ID, CASE WHEN C.MATCH_ID IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ocuoc_ocrwl_l WL WHERE WL.WK_ID = C.WK_ID AND WL.LEFRM_ID = C.MATCH_ID) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS LINK_YN FROM (SELECT WC.WK_ID, WC.CLASS_SEQ, WC.CLASS_NM, WC.DOC_TYP_CD, (SELECT MIN(F.LEFRM_ID) FROM ocuoc_lefrm_m F WHERE
) AS MATCH_ID FROM ocuoc_ocrwc_l WC) C
mapper.select: /* [업무·서식 연결] 업무별 연결 현황 - selectWorkflowList */ SELECT W.WK_ID AS wkId, W.WK_NM AS wkNm, W.WK_STAT_CD AS wkStatCd, TO_CHAR(W.SYNC_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS syncDt, COUNT(S.CLASS_SEQ) AS classCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN S.MATCH_ID IS NOT NULL AND S.LINK_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 END) AS linkedCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN S.MATCH_ID IS NOT NULL AND S.LINK_YN = 'N' THEN 1 END) AS pendingCnt, COUNT(CASE WHEN S.CLASS_SEQ IS NOT NULL AND S.MATCH_ID IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS unlinkedCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocuoc_ocrwl_l WL WHERE WL.WK_ID = W.WK_ID) AS formCnt FROM ocuoc_ocrwf_m W LEFT JOIN () S ON S.WK_ID = W.WK_ID GROUP BY W.WK_ID, W.WK_NM, W.WK_STAT_CD, W.SYNC_DT ORDER BY W.WK_NM, W.WK_ID

/* [업무·서식 연결] 서식 목록 - selectFormList */ SELECT L.LEFRM_ID AS lefrmId, L.LEFRM_NM AS lefrmNm, L.DOC_ID AS docId, L.REG_STA_CD AS regStaCd, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocuoc_ocrwl_l WL WHERE WL.LEFRM_ID = L.LEFRM_ID) AS linkCnt, TO_CHAR(NVL(L.CHNG_DT, L.REG_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS chngDt FROM ocuoc_lefrm_m L ORDER BY L.LEFRM_ID
/* [업무·서식 연결] 서식 1건 - selectForm */ SELECT L.LEFRM_ID AS lefrmId, L.LEFRM_NM AS lefrmNm, L.DOC_ID AS docId, L.REG_STA_CD AS regStaCd FROM ocuoc_lefrm_m L WHERE L.LEFRM_ID = #{lefrmId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT NVL(MAX(LEFRM_ID), 0) + 1 FROM ocuoc_lefrm_m
/* [업무·서식 연결] 서식 등록 - insertForm */ INSERT INTO ocuoc_lefrm_m (LEFRM_ID, LEFRM_NM, DOC_ID, REG_STA_CD, RGSR_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{form.lefrmId}, #{form.lefrmNm}, #{form.docId}, 'Y', #{userId}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: /* [업무·서식 연결] 서식 수정 - updateForm */ UPDATE ocuoc_lefrm_m SET LEFRM_NM = #{form.lefrmNm}, DOC_ID = #{form.docId}, EDTR_ID = #{userId}, CHNG_DT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE LEFRM_ID = #{form.lefrmId}
mapper.insert: /* [업무·서식 연결] 서식의 연결 다시 만들기 - insertLinksOfForm */ INSERT INTO ocuoc_ocrwl_l (WK_ID, LEFRM_ID, RGSR_ID, REG_DT) SELECT DISTINCT S.WK_ID, L.LEFRM_ID, #{userId}, SYSTIMESTAMP FROM () S JOIN ocuoc_lefrm_m L ON L.LEFRM_ID = S.MATCH_ID WHERE S.MATCH_ID = #{lefrmId} AND S.LINK_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: /* [업무·서식 연결] 메뉴 권한 확인 - countMenuPermission */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ocuoc_usrol_r R JOIN ocuoc_rolem_m RM ON RM.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID JOIN ocuoc_usmua_r U ON U.ROLE_ID = R.ROLE_ID JOIN ocuoc_menun_m M ON M.MENU_ID = U.MENU_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' AND RM.USE_YN = 'Y' AND U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND LTRIM(M.MENU_URL, '/') = #{menuUrl}
